newsitem.title: GERMANY: Daimler's Schrempp sees 1996 sales up 10-11 pct.
newsitem.headline: Daimler's Schrempp sees 1996 sales up 10-11 pct.

text.p: Daimler-Benz AG chairman Juergen Schrempp expects 1996 group sales growth of 10 to 11 percent and that nearly all units will progress according to plan or better, a German magazine reported on Thursday.
In an interview with WirthschaftsWoche, Schrempp said: "what is positive is that growth is coming in all branches, not only a single segment as in the past."
In 1995, Daimler reported group revenues of 103.55 billion marks ($69.2 billion).
Schrempp said he expected all Daimler branches to meet a return on a capital employed target of 12 percent by 1998 at the latest.
A Daimler spokesman confirmed Schrempp's remarks about sales and return on capital expectations, noting that the figures were in line with previous forecasts made by Daimler officials.
